name: Reken (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, black and yellow in the proportions 1:3:1, charged in the upper half with the municipal arms of Reken (a tree on yellow).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Münster of 16 January 1970 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a banner, described as yellow, black and yellow striped 1:3:1 with the arms in the middle of the upper half.
